svg.title: Matthew Valancy: Full-stack hardware + software engineer: from PCBs, CAD and robots to edge AI and the tools behind them.
svg.desc: The stack I build across, bottom to top: PCBs and electronics, CAD and mechanical, motors and robots, firmware, edge AI, apps and UI. Signals pulse up and down the links between the layers.
